source:
Write reference/bakeoff-full.json: every bake-off entry's per-task result on all 200 tasks, from our eval platform.

The 7 Codex arms come from the harness bake-off r2 (full/pertask.csv; Nov 12-13); browser-use 1.0.4rc1 from its
Nov 13 run (eval a1487b98, two judge crashes rejudged in e089dc24). Numbers only: score x100, minutes, model $ at the
bake-off basis ($1 / $0.10 cached / $5 out per 1M; Stagehand includes its own model calls), cloud $ (Codex arms).
